findings.reason: the node must either omit the control or report a set of figures its own done-when declares impossible, so the failed count has to enter the sum.
findings.text: the done-when asks for "the number of signals, of components and of field patterns left awaiting context, each with its described count summing to the pilot's total of that kind", but its own negative control requires a member of a group whose component description failed to be "reported in a failed state and carries no composed description"; that member has linked context, so it is not awaiting context, and it has no composed description, so it is not described, leaving the two figures unable to sum to the pilot's total once the control fires and no failed bucket in the reconciliation

findings.reason: the hand-reader's support test omits the two sources the description is explicitly composed from, so the quality bar can fail a description for doing what Delivers asks.
findings.text: the grade makes a description wrong for stating "something that neither the specification nor the signal's own recorded sources support", while Delivers (line 69) requires each member description to be "composed from the two" — the component description and the pattern description — so a proposition carried over from the component's linked context is supported by neither the specification (which need not state it for that signal) nor the signal's recorded vocabulary sources, and a correctly grounded description can be graded wrong
